column2: Retain accession at twenty-five, twenty-nine years in Jerusalem and Joaden from Jerusalem. The maternal place is not converted into a patronymic.
Retain doing right but not with a full heart. The qualification is integral to the evaluation and not omitted in favor of a simple favorable verdict.
Retain the kingdom established in his hand and execution of his servants who murdered his royal father. The royal subject and servants' responsibility are explicit.
Retain sparing their sons, the covenant of the Lord's law, both parent/child prohibitions and individual death for one's own sin. No Moses name is inserted into the selected citation formula.

Retain Judah's house organized by ancestral houses and commanders throughout Judah and Jerusalem, twenty and upward, and 300,000 spear and large-shield bearers. Jerusalem is not changed to Benjamin to match another form.
Retain 100,000 hired Israelite fighters for 100 talents of silver. The payment is a total, not a stated wage per man.

Retain the unnamed man of God, prohibition against Israel's force accompanying him and all Ephraim's sons in the explanation. The collective Israel/Ephraim relation is not expanded into a tribal census.

Retain conditional reliance on those men, the Lord routing him before enemies, and both strength and rout from the Lord. Do not replace this selected conditional with an imperative to strengthen himself.
Retain the concern about the paid 100 talents and the Lord's ability to give much more. No promise of a specified refund is added.
Retain separation of Ephraim's force, return to their place, anger against Judah and the repeated furious return. The repetition describes the dismissed soldiers rather than Amaziah's own army.
Retain Amaziah strengthening, taking his people, the Valley of Salts and 10,000 Seirites struck. No new casualty distinction is imported from another campaign account.
Retain another 10,000 captured alive, ascent to the cliff, repeated cliff-top reference, hurling down and all torn apart. The prisoners' killing is not softened into expulsion.
Retain the dismissed soldiers attacking Judah's cities from Samaria to Baithoron, 3,000 struck and much spoil. The surprising geographical range remains uncorrected.
Retain return after striking Idumea, bringing the gods to them, setting them up for himself, prostration and personal sacrifice. The selected plural them is not changed to a singular him.
column3: The antecedent of to them remains unresolved; worshiping the captured gods is explicit.

column2: Revise to that people's gods, who did not rescue their people, making the gods the clear antecedent of the relative clause. Replace could not rescue with did not rescue because the selected verb reports the failure without an explicit ability modal. Retain plural prophets and the Lord's wrath; preserve inherited wording as the close draft.

Retain the shift from plural prophets to a singular speaker, the royal counselor challenge, flogging threat, silence followed by speech and divine destruction inferred in He. Do not change flogging to killing or erase the silence/speech juxtaposition.
column3: The unnamed subject of purposed is contextually divine, and the singular/plural prophetic shift remains open.

column2: Retain Amaziah's consultation, Joash's Joachaz/Jehu ancestry and the face-to-face challenge. The challenge's military implication comes from context rather than an added fight verb.

Retain achouch, cedar, the marriage proposal, future arrival of the field animals followed by their past arrival and trampling. Do not silently identify the untranslated plant or regularize the tense change.
column3: Achouch requires lexical identification; the fable remains a provisional transliteration at that point.

column2: Change You say to You said to reflect the selected aorist while retaining the difficult second-person quotation, heavy heart, lifting, staying home and danger to both king and Judah. The close draft preserves the inherited present.
column3: The quotation boundaries and heavy-heart expression remain provisional; the second-person striking is not silently converted to I struck.

column2: Retain refusal to listen, the Lord's agency in delivery into hands and seeking Idumean gods. Others' supplies the unnamed human possessors contextually rather than claiming an explicit Greek pronoun.
Retain Joash's ascent and the kings meeting one another at Baithsamys belonging to Judah. Their similar names remain distinguished by royal titles.
Retain Judah's rout before Israel and each person's flight to a tent. The distributive each is not reduced to an undifferentiated national retreat.
Retain capture of Amaziah son of Joash by Israel's Joash, bringing him into Jerusalem and removal of 400 cubits from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate. The capture and transport are both expressed.

Retain gold, silver, temple articles, Abdedom, royal treasures, sons of the mixed company and return to Samaria. He took supplies a governing action to the selected object list without claiming a separately expressed verb.
column3: Sons of the mixed company and its possible relation to hostages remain unresolved; do not silently replace the phrase.

column2: Retain Amaziah surviving Israel's Joash by fifteen years and both paternal identifications. The interval is not a new fifteen-year total reign.
Retain first and last acts and the question referring to the kings of Judah and Israel. The documentary notice is not evidence that its named source has been independently consulted.
Retain departure from the Lord, the attack formed, flight to Lachis, pursuit there and killing. The attackers remain unnamed.
Retain transport on horses and burial with the fathers in David's city. David's city is not replaced with city of Judah from another textual form.
Retain all the land's people appointing sixteen-year-old Uzziah in Amaziah's place. The age is repeated later and not deleted here.
Retain building Ailath, restoring it to Judah and the temporal clause after the king's sleep with his fathers. The repeated he emphasizes the builder rather than naming a different king.
column3: The preceding king in the death clause is contextual; no extra personal name is inserted.

column2: Retain sixteen at accession, fifty-two years in Jerusalem and Chalia from Jerusalem. No different maternal name is imported.
Retain doing right according to all Amaziah had done. The scope follows this evaluative sentence without erasing Amaziah's previously narrated failures.
Retain Zacharias understanding the Lord's fear, repeated seeking during his days and the Lord granting prosperity. Fear is not replaced with visions or a claim that he taught Uzziah.
column3: The possessive in his days remains contextually linked to Zacharias; its repetition is preserved.

column2: Retain warfare against foreigners, three distinct wall-demolition notices and cities of Azotus and among foreigners. No conjectural technical designation for the new cities is supplied.
Retain the Lord strengthening Uzziah against foreigners, rock-dwelling Arabs and Minaeans. Rock is not silently turned into a different place name.
Retain Minaeans giving gifts, fame reaching Egypt's entrance and exceptional strength. Minaeans is not changed to Ammonites to harmonize another account.
Retain towers at Jerusalem, Corner Gate, Ravine Gate and corners, followed by his strengthening. The unexpressed object does not require silently supplying fortified them.
Retain wilderness towers, hewn cisterns, herds in Sephela/plain, vinedressers in hill country/Carmel and his love of farming. No separate farmers group is inserted beside the expressed vinedressers.

Retain ordered military forces, Iiel the scribe, Maasaias the judge and Ananias the royal deputy. Recorded and under make the hand-mediated administration readable without replacing judge with a different office.
column3: Deputy is a provisional rendering of the court title also encountered in earlier roster material.

column2: Retain 2,600 ancestral rulers mighty for war. These leaders are counted separately from the following full fighting force.
Retain 307,500 fighters, their mighty strength and help for the king against adversaries. No numerical harmonization is attempted.
Retain preparation for the whole force and all six equipment categories, including slings for stones. Do not collapse shields, breastplates and helmets into generic armor.

Retain devised machines, designer, tower/corner positions, missiles and large stones, and the construction's distant renown. Their construction is not rewritten as his fame; marvelous help remains without an expressly named helper.
column3: The technical devices and precise force of the construction/renown clause require specialist review; no modern artillery identification is claimed.

column2: Retain strength leading to an elevated heart toward destruction, injustice against his God and entry to burn incense. The unfavorable heart image differs contextually from 17:6.
Retain Azarias following him and eighty mighty priests of the Lord. The eighty are the accompanying priests, not an inferred total including Azarias.

Retain priestly opposition, Aaron's consecrated sons as incense ministers, the command to leave, departure from the Lord and no glory from God. Ordinary you addresses a human king even within religious admonition.
Retain anger, censer, purpose of incense, the skin affliction appearing on the forehead before priests in God's house above the incense altar. Above is not changed to beside without evidence.
column3: Leprosy is inherited ancient-disease terminology, not a confirmed modern diagnosis; spatial and disease vocabulary remain open.

column2: Retain chief priest and priests turning, forehead affliction, their hurrying him out and his own haste because the Lord rebuked him. Rebuked is not replaced with a different strike verb.

Retain lifelong affliction, repeated leprous status in a house of apphousoth, separation from the Lord's house and Jotham administering the kingdom and judging. Do not silently turn apphousoth into an assured isolation-house designation.
column3: Apphousoth remains untranslated and provisional; its lexical resolution is required before literary acceptance.

column2: Retain first and last acts recorded by Jessias the prophet. Do not change the selected name to Isaiah son of Amoz without separate textual evidence.
Retain sleep and burial with fathers in the field of the kings' burial, the stated affliction as reason and Jotham's succession. Field of burial is distinct from direct placement in royal tombs.
